a: Release, experiment, ops, and permission flags serve different purposes.
Target by user id, percentage rollout, plan, or attributes.
Sticky assignment keeps a user in the same variant for consistency.
Remove stale flags after full rollout to reduce complexity.
Fail closed or open intentionally when the flag service is down.
Evaluate flags server-side for security-sensitive features.
Multivariate flags test more than two variants.
Audit who changed flags and when for incident response.
Flags toggle behavior; config holds non-boolean settings.
Kill switches instantly disable risky features in production.
